operations.name: workflow-title
operations.text: SLAM 的整体流程

operations.name: workflow-subtitle
operations.text: 观测 → 前端约束 → 后端优化 → 地图更新；地图继续约束下一帧定位

operations.name: map-feedback-label
operations.text: 地图 / 局部结构为下一帧匹配提供约束

operations.name: stage-1-title
operations.text: 传感器观测

operations.name: stage-1-body
operations.text:
LiDAR / 相机 / 深度
IMU / 轮速等运动信息
按系统配置选择

operations.name: stage-2-title
operations.text: 预处理

operations.name: stage-2-body
operations.text:
时间同步与外参
去畸变 / 有效值检查
特征及可靠性筛选

operations.name: stage-3-title
operations.text: 前端：跟踪与关联

operations.name: stage-3-body
operations.text:
帧间 / 帧地图匹配
运动初值与相对约束
关键帧选择

operations.name: stage-4-title
operations.text: 后端：联合估计

operations.name: stage-4-body
operations.text:
融合观测与运动约束
优化位姿 / 偏置等
可含地图变量

operations.name: stage-5-title
operations.text: 地图融合与更新

operations.name: stage-5-body
operations.text:
用估计位姿融合观测
静态结构与变化管理
局部 / 全局地图

operations.name: joint-estimation-note
operations.text:
位姿影响地图，地图影响后续位姿。
误差会沿这个反馈关系传播。

operations.name: pose-output
operations.text:
输出 ① 位姿 / 轨迹
实时跟踪 + 后端校正

operations.name: loop-validation
operations.text:
回环检测与验证
历史关键帧
几何一致性约束

operations.name: map-output
operations.text:
输出 ② 环境地图
点云 / 栅格 / 特征等

operations.name: experiment-scope
operations.text: 本轮实验：给定建图位姿 A → 清理并冻结地图 → 独立扫描 B 定位；该对照用于隔离地图因素。

operations.name: workflow-footnote
operations.text: 通用功能流程；各 SLAM 系统的模块划分和状态变量可不同。

operations.name: factors-title
operations.text: 影响鲁棒定位与 SLAM 的因素和实例

operations.name: factors-subtitle
operations.text: 读法：因素 → 典型实例 → 影响机制；右侧虚线框用于插入实测图。

operations.name: F01-heading
operations.text: F01  采样与可见性

operations.name: F01-example
operations.text: 例：远处细柱 / 大面积遮挡

operations.name: F01-mechanism
operations.text: 稀疏、低重叠 → 匹配与建图约束不足

operations.name: F01-image-slot
operations.text:
F01 配图位
稀疏 / 遮挡

operations.name: F02-heading
operations.text: F02  运动与扫描畸变

operations.name: F02-example
operations.text: 例：快速转弯 / 振动 / 轮胎打滑

operations.name: F02-mechanism
operations.text: 扫描拉弯或运动先验失真 → 错误对齐

operations.name: F02-image-slot
operations.text:
F02 配图位
转弯 / 墙面

operations.name: F03-heading
operations.text: F03  时间与空间标定

operations.name: F03-example
operations.text: 例：LiDAR–IMU 时间差 / 外参偏差

operations.name: F03-mechanism
operations.text: 跨传感器错位 → 双墙与位姿偏差

operations.name: F03-image-slot
operations.text:
F03 配图位
错位 / 双墙

operations.name: F04-heading
operations.text: F04  动态物体与持久变化

operations.name: F04-example
operations.text: 例：行人经过 / 停车 / 桌椅搬动

operations.name: F04-mechanism
operations.text: 残影、遮挡或地图过期 → 误匹配

operations.name: F04-image-slot
operations.text:
F04 配图位
动态残影

operations.name: F05-heading
operations.text: F05  材质与成像条件

operations.name: F05-example
operations.text: 例：镜面 / 玻璃 / 深度相机强光

operations.name: F05-mechanism
operations.text: 虚假点、穿透或缺测 → 伪结构与空洞

operations.name: F05-image-slot
operations.text:
F05 配图位
镜面 / 异常点

operations.name: F06-heading
operations.text: F06  几何与外观退化

operations.name: F06-example
operations.text: 例：平行长走廊 / 白墙 / 重复门

operations.name: F06-mechanism
operations.text: 方向约束弱或易混淆 → 漂移 / 误关联

operations.name: F06-image-slot
operations.text:
F06 配图位
长走廊

operations.name: F07-heading
operations.text: F07  位姿漂移与错误回环

operations.name: F07-example
operations.text: 例：累计偏航 / 相似走廊误闭环

operations.name: F07-mechanism
operations.text: 地图错层或拉扯 → 后续定位被误导

operations.name: F07-image-slot
operations.text:
F07 配图位
轨迹 / 错层

operations.name: F08-heading
operations.text: F08  地图表示与实时预算

operations.name: F08-example
operations.text: 例：体素过粗 / 过度滤波 / 处理积压

operations.name: F08-mechanism
operations.text: 细节丢失、延迟 → 有效约束减少

operations.name: F08-image-slot
operations.text:
F08 配图位
细节 / 延迟

operations.name: factor-caveat
operations.text: 静态不等于可信；干净不等于约束充分；未观测不等于自由空间。各因素可同时出现。

operations.name: workflow-subtitle
operations.text: Observations → front-end constraints → optimization → map update → next-frame tracking

operations.name: factors-title
operations.text: Factors and examples affecting robust localization and SLAM

operations.name: factors-subtitle
operations.text: Read each entry as factor → example → mechanism. Dashed slots are reserved for your images.

operations.name: F01-heading
operations.text: F01  Sampling and visibility

operations.name: F01-example
operations.text: E.g. distant poles / heavy occlusion

operations.name: F01-mechanism
operations.text: Sparse, low-overlap support weakens matching.

operations.name: F01-image-slot
operations.text:
F01 IMAGE SLOT
Sparse scan / occluded scene

operations.name: F02-heading
operations.text: F02  Motion and scan distortion

operations.name: F02-example
operations.text: E.g. fast turns / vibration / wheel slip

operations.name: F02-mechanism
operations.text: Warped scans or a biased motion prior misalign.

operations.name: F02-image-slot
operations.text:
F02 IMAGE SLOT
Turning scan / warped wall

operations.name: F03-heading
operations.text: F03  Timing and calibration

operations.name: F03-example
operations.text: E.g. LiDAR–IMU time / extrinsic offsets

operations.name: F03-mechanism
operations.text: Cross-sensor misalignment creates double walls.

operations.name: F03-image-slot
operations.text:
F03 IMAGE SLOT
Time offset / double wall

operations.name: F04-heading
operations.text: F04  Dynamics and lasting change

operations.name: F04-example
operations.text: E.g. walking / parking / moved furniture

operations.name: F04-mechanism
operations.text: Ghosts, occlusion or stale maps mislead matching.

operations.name: F04-image-slot
operations.text:
F04 IMAGE SLOT
Ghosts / changed scene

operations.name: F05-heading
operations.text: F05  Materials and imaging

operations.name: F05-example
operations.text: E.g. mirrors / glass / depth in strong light

operations.name: F05-mechanism
operations.text: False or missing returns create wrong geometry.

operations.name: F05-image-slot
operations.text:
F05 IMAGE SLOT
Mirror / anomalous returns

operations.name: F06-heading
operations.text: F06  Geometry and appearance

operations.name: F06-example
operations.text: E.g. parallel corridor / blank or repeated walls

operations.name: F06-mechanism
operations.text: Weak or ambiguous support causes drift / aliasing.

operations.name: F06-image-slot
operations.text:
F06 IMAGE SLOT
Corridor / repeated structures

operations.name: F07-heading
operations.text: F07  Pose drift and false loops

operations.name: F07-example
operations.text: E.g. yaw drift / similar corridors closed wrongly

operations.name: F07-mechanism
operations.text: Misplaced or warped maps corrupt later tracking.

operations.name: F07-image-slot
operations.text:
F07 IMAGE SLOT
Trajectory / misaligned map

operations.name: F08-heading
operations.text: F08  Map representation and compute

operations.name: F08-example
operations.text: E.g. coarse voxels / heavy filtering / backlog

operations.name: F08-mechanism
operations.text: Lost detail and stale updates reduce useful support.

operations.name: F08-image-slot
operations.text:
F08 IMAGE SLOT
Detail loss / processing delay

operations.name: factor-caveat
operations.text: Static ≠ reliable; clean ≠ sufficiently constrained; unobserved ≠ free. Factors can co-occur.

ambiguity: All examples are conceptual. Image slots are empty until user evidence is supplied; they do not report experimental outcomes.
